lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately six longitudinal rows posterior to the gill slits, with inter-centroid spacing increasing significantly along the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs to form a rectilinear grid, most visible in the mid-flank region between the pectoral and dorsal fins.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a high-intensity dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, dark, oblong anomaly is visible attached to the trailing edge of the right pectoral fin, potentially indicating a parasitic attachment or localized tissue trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The right pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small, high-luminance spots concentrated towards the leading edge and distal tip, contrasting with the larger, more sparse blobs on the flank.
